definitions.gloss: playing from memory; memorizing a musical score; performing without sheet music
definitions.explanation: The act of memorizing a piece of music well enough to perform it without looking at the sheet music. A key skill for musicians, especially in classical music performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{暗譜|あんぷ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{暗譜|あんぷ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}する→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}する→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧。
examples.english: Performing from memory makes me nervous.

notes: Composed of {暗|あん} (memorization, by heart) + {譜|ふ} (musical score). Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb: {暗譜|あんぷ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to memorize a piece of music). Common collocations: {暗譜|あんぷ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧ (to play from memory), {暗譜|あんぷ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}する→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧ (to perform from memory). In classical piano and violin recitals, {暗譜|あんぷ} is generally expected. Related: ⟦{暗記|あんき}→暗記：01701_anki⟧ (memorization — general), ⟦{楽譜|がくふ}→楽譜：06987_gakufu⟧ (sheet music).
